issue_title: A full table export returns only part of a large table
issue_body: Requesting a complete export of a table returns only a portion of the rows when the table is large. Smaller tables export in full. The returned output is well-formed but cuts off early, omitting later rows.
prompt: Requesting a complete export of a table returns only a portion of the rows when the table is large. Smaller tables export in full. The returned output is well-formed but cuts off early, omitting later rows.
expected_behavior: A streaming CSV download includes all rows from the table.
Row count in the downloaded file matches the total table size.
Column headers appear once at the top of the file.
